item.text: {"search_note":"I found no 2024 source in which Tinubu invoked nuclear weapons, nuclear deterrence, or nuclear ambiguity to justify conventional force, territorial pressure, or repression. I also found no evidence that Nigeria had a nuclear weapons capability to wield in the first place; the 2024 record is instead consistent with civilian nuclear regulation and disarmament norms.","evidence":[{"title":"President Tinubu Signs Four New Nuclear Safety Regulations","publisher":"Nigerian Nuclear Regulatory Authority (NNRA)","date":"2024","url":"https://www.nnra.gov.ng/nnra/post-president_tinubu_signs_four_new_nuclear_safety_regulations","summary":"Tinubu signed four new nuclear safety regulations covering nuclear power plant design/construction, transport of radioactive material, basic ionizing radiation, and radioactive waste/spent fuel management. This is strong evidence of civilian nuclear governance and safety discipline, not nuclear shielding of coercion.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.3","1B.4"]},{"title":"Honourable Minister of Defence of Nigeria Addresses the United Nations on Nuclear Disarmament","publisher":"Ministry of Defence, Nigeria","date":"September 28, 2024","url":"https://defence.gov.ng/2024/09/28/honourable-minister-of-defence-of-nigeria-addresses-the-united-nations-on-nuclear-disarmament/","summary":"Nigeria reaffirmed commitment to nuclear disarmament and nonproliferation, urged NPT compliance, endorsed the TPNW, and supported peaceful nuclear energy under IAEA monitoring. This is the clearest 2024 evidence against nuclear-capability signaling or nuclear-backed coercion.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.4","1B.1","1B.2"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Calls for Suspension of Sanctions on Guinea, Mali, Niger, Burkina Faso","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"February 24, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-calls-for-suspension-of-sanctions-on-guinea-mali-niger-burkina-faso/","summary":"Tinubu argued sanctions had become ineffective and said there was “a better path” through negotiation and improved governance. This is de-escalatory diplomacy, not brinkmanship, and there is no nuclear component to the posture.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.4","1B.1","1B.2"]},{"title":"President Tinubu’s Statement on the Killings of Soldiers in Aba","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"June 2, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-statement-on-the-killings-of-soldiers-in-aba/","summary":"Tinubu threatened to come down heavily on attackers and said the government and armed forces had the capacity to crush violent non-state actors. This is negative context for coercive conventional security behavior, but it still does not show any use of nuclear capability as cover.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.1"]}]}
